title.zh: 破产、重组与解散（第 5A 与 10A 部分的规定期间）命令 2021
title.en: Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution (Prescribed Periods for Parts 5A and 10A) Order 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution (Prescribed Periods for Parts 5A and 10A) Order 2021 and comes into operation on 29 January 2021.

heading.en: Prescribed period for purposes of Part 5A of Act

text.en: 2. For the purposes of Part 5A of the Act, the prescribed period is 6 months commencing on 29 January 2021.

heading.en: Prescribed period for purposes of Part 10A of Act

text.en: 3. For the purposes of Part 10A of the Act, the prescribed period is 6 months commencing on 29 January 2021.
